mapper.sql: SELECT se.id, se.enterprise_name, se.unified_social_credit_code, se.admin_user as adminUserId, su.nickname as adminUserName, se.status, se.create_time FROM system_enterprise se left join system_users su on (se.admin_user = su.id and su.delete_flag = 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM system_enterprise WHERE enterprise_name = #{enterpriseName} and delete_flag = 0
select id, enterprise_name from system_enterprise where delete_flag = 0 and status = 0
